Bill.BriefDescription: Creating the wildlife conservationist award program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to wildlife conservation awards; and adding a newsection to chapter 77.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The wildlife conservationist award program is created in thedepartment. The purpose of the program is to recognize individuals whohave made outstanding contributions toward conserving Washington'sdiverse plant and animal populations. (2) The program consists of two annual awards as follows: (a) The Art Kruckeberg award shall be presented to an individualmaking outstanding contributions toward conserving the state's plantsand plant communities; and (b) The Hazel Wolf award shall be presented to an individual makingoutstanding contributions toward conserving the state's animals andanimal communities. (3) The recipient of each award is entitled to select a nonprofitwildlife conservation organization to receive a sum of up to twentyfive thousand dollars from the state. The organization must be p. 1 SB 5016qualified as a taxexempt organization under section 501(c)(3) of thefederal internal revenue code (26 U.S.C. Sec. 501(c)(3)), and mustagree to commit the sum to the organization's wildlife conservationactivities in Washington. (4) The department must develop guidelines for selecting awardrecipients and incorporate into the program elements that provide forpublic recognition of the contributions made by the recipients. Thedepartment may create an advisory committee to assist the department indeveloping the guidelines and in selecting recipients.
